detail.title: Synthesis of Information Persistence Mechanisms
detail.summary: This research journal entry synthesizes findings from information survival studies. We examine the intersection of physical error-correction mechanisms and institutional frameworks that promote knowledge retention. The focus remains on differentiating structural integrity from the social relevance required for long-term transmission.

children.title: Duality of Information Persistence: Technical and Institutional

detail.title: Duality of Information Persistence: Technical and Institutional
detail.summary: Information persistence functions through two distinct but overlapping regimes: technical error-correction, which mitigates physical entropy (e.g., quantum information preservation), and institutional/economic mechanisms, which ensure information remains useful and relevant within a social context.
detail.reason: This notebook synthesizes the two available sources for project proj-info-survival-002 to satisfy the commitment of drafting a provisional synthesis.
